description: Data payload shape of 'policy.get' and 'policy.set' (envelope.data) — the three-layer policy stack (docs/GUI-ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL.md section 7.2). policy.get fills layers/effective/attribution and nulls layer/key/value/path; policy.set does the inverse. baseline is never writable.

layers.description: Raw per-layer file content for policy.get (null layer = file absent), or null for policy.set.

sqlite.description: Effective state projected from manager.db when SQLite storage is active (Phase 1A); baseline/synced/local are null in that mode. Absent or null otherwise.

effective.description: Merged result (baseline + synced + local, agent ids canonicalized) for policy.get, or null for policy.set. Free-form object.

attribution.description: Top-level key -> last defining layer ('baseline'|'synced'|'local'), for policy.get; null for policy.set. Free-form object.

layer.description: Layer written by policy.set ('synced'|'local'), or null for policy.get.

key.description: Dot-path written by policy.set, or null for policy.get.

value.description: Value written by policy.set (any JSON), or null for policy.get. Untyped by design: the policy tree is free-form below top level.

path.description: Layer file written by policy.set, or null for policy.get.
